plugin.name: RehearsalPlayer
plugin.title: Rehearsal Player
plugin.desc: Dark, playlist-driven rehearsal playback with tutor/class filters, artwork playlist selection, large transport controls, quick jump presets, and a Spotify-backed teacher playlist sidebar.
plugin.changes: Added a static teacher playlist sidebar backed by the official Spotify Web API: browse and (with playback plugins such as Spotty) play a teacher's Spotify playlist, connect your own Spotify account to search and add tracks to any collaborative playlist shown, and administer playlists/icons/links from the plugin settings page.
plugin.creator: Jazzart
